content.title: About Backpack (BP)
content.description: Backpack is an integrated cryptocurrency ecosystem that combines a security-focused, multi-chain self-custodial wallet with a regulated centralized exchange.

content.title: About TRUMP
content.description: TRUMP is a politics-themed digital coin built on the Solana blockchain that uses the brand of Donald Trump to foster a community-driven ecosystem.

content.title: PENGU is the official coin of Pudgy Penguins.
content.description: Pudgy Penguins has become the face of crypto with one of the most influential communities in the industry. From large companies wearing the Penguin, to being featured in ETF commercials, to garnering millions of followers and over 100 billion views, the Pengu has become a cultural icon making PENGU the world’s social currency.

content.title: About Zcash (ZEC)
content.description: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses advanced trustless zero-knowledge proofs to enable fully encrypted transactions while maintaining blockchain transparency and security.

content.title: What is Basic Attention Token?
content.description: A very common question when it comes to Basic Attention Token (BAT) is: “Why would Brave Browser need a token (BAT) for this?”. And the answer lies within Brave’s unusual, yet respectful approach to digital advertising. Brave’s advertisements are privacy centric (does not track the user), and are opt-in only (you only see it if you choose to).

content.title: What is Cosmos Hub (ATOM)?
content.description: The Cosmos network consists of many independent, parallel blockchains, called zones, each powered by classical Byzantine fault-tolerant (BFT) consensus protocols like Tendermint. Some zones act as hubs with respect to other zones, allowing many zones to interoperate through a shared hub.

content.title: About Ethereum
content.description: Ethereum is a blockchain platform that enables developers to build and deploy smart contracts and decentralized applications, operating through thousands of independent nodes worldwide rather than through a central authority.

content.title: What is Jupiter?
content.description: Jupiter is a decentralized exchange (DEX) aggregator that allows users to swap tokens at optimal prices with low slippage and transaction fees in the Solana ecosystem. It also provides users the optimal routes for direct swaps between multiple exchanges and liquidity pools.

content.title: About Kaia
content.description: Kaia is an Ethereum-equivalent Layer 1 public blockchain that brings Web3 to the fingertips of hundreds of millions across Asia via their preferred messenger superapps. Kaia utilizes Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerance (pBFT), a highly-optimized version of BFT to achieve 4,000 real-world TPS while delivering 1-second block time with immediate absolute finality, which allows for near-instant transactions.
